name: LIVING MUD SCRUM — Sprint 2: NPC voices + world memory

lanes.prompt: You are the Kabuki casting director. The MUD needs NPC voices. Read watch/inbox/SHITPOST_DESK_ANTHROPIC_PRIMER_20260922.md (Diamond Age sections) + corpus/oral_history/LETTER_TO_DAUGHTER.md (GPS for problems) + watch/inbox/CONVERGENCE_RUBIK_GRAPH_20260922.md. Design 5 NPC voice cards for the Living Mud: name, room, speech pattern, what they teach the player without lecturing, 3 sample lines each. The cast: the Night Archivist (tames knots), the GPS Cartographer (draws problem-maps), the Card Dealer (deterministic), the Wall Walker (tafl/kendall), the Cycle Keeper (birth-death-water). One voice card per NPC, game-ready.

You are a puzzle smith. Read dashboard/static/games/mud.html (sample the parser + room commands) and memory/game_modules/dnd_classic_stub.v1.json (rumors, encounters, loot structure) + watch/corpus/ONE_WAY_MIRROR_RSVP_20260922.md (the double-sided reading doctrine). Design ONE puzzle chain for the Living Mud using ONLY borrowed mechanics: a door that reads differently from two sides (RSVP), a light-gated corridor (spectral/eraser lineage), a water valve (water_computer lineage). Output: the puzzle chain spec — 3 rooms, what each teaches, the win condition, and how the ENGINE (not the LLM) verifies each step. Under 2000 chars of mechanics.

You are the world's memory designer. The Living Mud must REMEMBER players (the actual Primer property). Read watch/inbox/games_polish/p01-shadowbonk.md (audit example) and memory/biography/knot_timeline.jsonl (first 50 lines — the time-series format). Design: what the MUD remembers per visitor (visits, choices, rooms walked — stored as F1-style canonical strings), how long-term changes persist (the world shifts based on aggregate player actions — knots on the world's own chain), and the privacy line (what is never stored). Under 1500 words of design.

You are an integration engineer. Read watch/inbox/BUILD_ORDER_LIVING_MUD_20260922.md (the two-tier architecture: local tier live AI via loopback :4096, public tier curated) and site/build.py (how the beacon assembles). Design the MUD pane integration: where the Living Mud room sits in the beacon's room flow, how the local tier detects the :4096 lane and falls back to curated lines when absent, and the exact insertion points in site/build.py (GAMES list, PAGES list, index). Cite line numbers from build.py. Engineering spec, no code.
